title: 10 量骨11 识字12 养身
slug: 我有装备栏460上次那一位
content_zh:
;;
齐知玄走上前敲门。
嘭嘭两声响。
一个青年探出脑袋，声如狮吼，问道：“你找谁？”
齐知玄连道：“大哥，我来拜师学武。”
青年招手道：“你来巧了，师父刚起床，进来吧。”
齐知玄快步进门，绕过照壁，旋即看到一个大院子。
十多个少年少女，正在铺满沙子的地上操练，一个个挥洒汗水，虎虎生风。
齐知玄看着他们激情四射的模样，不由得生出一种热血沸腾之感。
屋檐下。
一个须发皆白的花甲老者，正在悠然打着养身太极。
青年带着齐知玄来到老者面前，朗声道：“师父，他想拜师。”
老者正是秦守正，语气平淡地问道：“知道拜师的规矩吗？”
齐知玄立刻掏出一百泥钞递出去。
秦守正收下钱，放进口袋里，点头道：“我先给你量骨，如果你的根骨很好，那我不但会收你为徒，这一百泥钞也会退还给你，反之……”
齐知玄表示明白。
下一刻，秦守正抬手拍了下齐知玄的肩膀。
砰！
齐知玄浑身一震，全身止不住颤抖，剧烈颤抖，就连牙齿都在打颤。
这种状态持续了五秒钟才停下。

秦守正捋了捋胡须，缓缓道：“年龄十七，身子骨没有长开，气血不足，但没什么大病。”
“可惜，可惜！”
他接连说了两个可惜，摇了摇头。
齐知玄脸色一变，问道：“我的根骨，不好？”
秦守正仔细讲道：“你的根骨其实是好的，中上之姿，但很可惜，你已经十七岁了，加上身子骨太弱，哪怕从现在开始滋补疗养、打熬筋骨，至少需要三年才能达到‘搬血境’的基本要求，那时候你已经二十岁了，错过了习武的黄金时段。”
齐知玄听懂了。
他的身子骨太差，需要先养三年，等身体变得壮实，才能具备练武的基本条件。
练武是以身体为根基，为底子。
齐知玄长期营养不良，哪有一点底子？
片刻后。
齐知玄离开秦氏武馆，接着来到了邓氏武馆。
他见到了邓劲光。
邓师傅比秦守正年轻，却也两鬓斑白，显露出了衰老之相。
content_en:
;;
Qi Zhixuan stepped forward and knocked on the door.
Two bang bang sounds.
A young man stuck his head out and asked with a roar like a lion: "Who are you looking for?"
Qi Zhixuan said: "Brother, I'm here to learn martial arts from my master."
The young man beckoned: "You are here by chance. Master has just gotten up. Come in."
Qi Zhixuan walked in quickly, walked around the screen wall, and immediately saw a large courtyard.
More than a dozen boys and girls are practicing on the sand-covered ground, each one sweating and vigorous.
Qi Zhixuan couldn't help but feel excited when he saw their passionate expressions.
Under the eaves.
An old man with white beard and hair in his sixties was leisurely practicing Tai Chi for health.
The young man brought Qi Zhixuan to the old man and said loudly: "Master, he wants to become a disciple."
The old man was Qin Shouzheng, and he asked in a calm tone: "Do you know the rules of apprenticeship?"
Qi Zhixuan immediately took out a hundred clay notes and handed it over.
Qin Shouzheng accepted the money, put it in his pocket, nodded and said: "I will measure your bones first. If your bones are very good, then not only will I accept you as my disciple, but I will also return the hundred yuan to you, and vice versa..."
Qi Zhixuan expressed his understanding.
The next moment, Qin Shouzheng raised his hand and patted Qi Zhixuan's shoulder.
Bang!
Qi Zhixuan was shocked, his whole body couldn't stop shaking, he was shaking violently, and even his teeth were chattering.
This state lasted for five seconds before stopping.
Qin Shouzheng stroked his beard and said slowly: "I am seventeen years old, my body bones have not grown, and my energy and blood are insufficient, but I have no serious illness."
"What a pity, what a pity!"
He said two regrets in succession and shook his head.
Qi Zhixuan's expression changed and he asked, "Is my root bad?"
Qin Shouzheng said carefully: "Your bones are actually good, with an average appearance, but unfortunately, you are already seventeen years old, and your body bones are too weak. Even if you start to nourish and recuperate and strengthen your muscles and bones from now on, it will take at least three years to reach the basic requirements of the 'Blood Moving Realm'. By then, you will be twenty years old and miss the prime time for martial arts practice."
Qi Zhixuan understood.
His body bones are too weak and he needs to be raised for three years before his body becomes strong enough to have the basic conditions for martial arts training.
Martial arts training is based on the body.
Qi Zhixuan has been malnourished for a long time, how can he have any foundation?
After a while.
Qi Zhixuan left Qin's Martial Arts School and then came to Deng's Martial Arts School.
He met Deng Jinguang.
Master Deng is younger than Qin Shouzheng, but he also has gray hair on his temples, showing his age.
